description: Versioned calculation conventions. Every chart result reports the convention it was computed with (`calculation_convention`). A convention id never changes meaning; a change of rules is a new id.

kefer-positions/1.corrections: apparent (light-time, deflection, aberration); geometric on request
kefer-positions/1.nutation: excluded (longitude = true-equinox longitude - IAU 2000A nutation in longitude)
kefer-positions/1.sidereal_time: GMST, classic UT-based polynomial; UT1 = UTC
kefer-positions/1.houses_and_axes: RAMC = GMST + east longitude; mean obliquity

kefer-positions/1-true-equinox.nutation: included: IAU 2000A (Rust sofars nut06a, Python Skyfield iau2000a; agree to micro-arcseconds)
kefer-positions/1-true-equinox.sidereal_time: GMST (classic UT-based polynomial) + equation of the equinoxes (Rust ee06a, Python Skyfield GAST-GMST); UT1 = UTC
kefer-positions/1-true-equinox.obliquity: IAU 2006 mean obliquity + nutation in obliquity
kefer-positions/1-true-equinox.houses_and_axes: RAMC = GAST + east longitude; true obliquity
kefer-positions/1-true-equinox.difference_from_default: longitudes + nutation in longitude (|dpsi| <= ~17.2 arcsec); ASC/MC differ by up to ~32 arcsec at the reference epochs
kefer-positions/1-true-equinox.selection: chart config field `calculation_convention`; absent means the default
kefer-positions/1-true-equinox.equatorial_outputs: right_ascension/declination stay on the mean equator of date in both conventions (Rust); see capabilities

rules: An implementation must never compute a convention it does not implement by silently using another; it must reject the request or attach a warning naming both conventions.
Changing the default convention is a breaking change: new minor version before 1.0, major after.
Results report the convention actually used in `calculation_convention`; an unknown id yields the warning `calculation_convention_unsupported: <id>; kefer-positions/1_used`.
